info.name: ArtifyMe API · Ready to Use (existing users)
info.description:
# ArtifyMe API - ready-to-use Postman collection

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8080` - the portable edition currently running on this machine.

## Existing users (all can sign in now)

| Role | Name | Email | Password | User ID |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ADMIN` | Ganesh Terkar | `ganesh@example.com` | `password123` | `11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111` |
| `ADMIN` | Admin Tester | `testadmin2@artifyme.com` | `password123` | `22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222` |
| `CUSTOMER` | Priya Patel | `priya.customer@example.com` | `password123` | `17c74a5c-ab7e-495c-a214-6bf48ce94377` |
| `ARTIST` | Rohan Sharma (verified) | `rohan.artist@example.com` | `password123` | `591fe88e-a0d2-40e2-8edf-f184bded8c3f` |
| `DELIVERY_AGENT` | Vikram Courier (created by this collection, PENDING) | `courier.vikram@example.com` | `password123` | `e39a0201-5fde-4758-b80f-edb4dcd22fa8` |

> The demo seed does not create a courier. The collection includes a one-click **Register - DELIVERY AGENT** request. The portable database used for validation already has the courier account above; use **05 -> ADMIN -> Activate delivery agent** to move it to `ACTIVE`.

## Quick start

1. Import this collection (and optionally `ArtifyMe.postman_environment.json`).
2. Select the **ArtifyMe - Local (portable)** environment in the top-right selector.
3. Open **00 - Authentication & Tokens** and send the login requests. Each login saves its JWT automatically into `adminToken`, `customerToken`, `artistToken`, `deliveryToken` and related variables.
4. Send **Sync demo order IDs** and **Sync user IDs** at the bottom of the same folder. These refresh every demo UUID from the live database - **run them again after any re-seed**.
5. Open any role folder and send requests - authorization is already wired per folder.

## Demo orders (auto-synced)

| Variable | State |
| --- | --- |
| `orderIdPlaced` | `PLACED` |
| `orderIdConfirmed` | `CONFIRMED` |
| `orderIdAssigned` | `ASSIGNED_ARTIST` |
| `orderIdInProgress` | `IN_PROGRESS` |
| `orderIdCompleted` | `COMPLETED` (not published) |
| `orderIdPublished` | `PUBLISHED` |

The environment values are current at the last sync; the **Sync demo order IDs** request updates them automatically if the demo data is re-seeded.

## Payments

The **server** decides the payment mode; Postman cannot switch it.

| Server configuration | Checkout behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=manual` (portable default) | Returns `200` with a mock `checkout_url`; **no money moves**. An admin confirms with **Confirm payment**. |
| `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=razorpay` + `rzp_test_…` keys, `PAYMENTS_LIVE=false` | Returns `key_id`, `razorpay_order_id`, `amount_paise` for Checkout.js. Test cards/UPI move **no real money** and need no KYC. |
| `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=razorpay` + `rzp_live_…` keys, `PAYMENTS_LIVE=true` | **Real money.** Requires KYC and a public HTTPS webhook; do not use the portable/localhost build for this. |

Payment requests in this collection:

- **02 → Checkout** — manual mock or Razorpay order; saves `razorpayOrderId`, `paymentId`, `paymentAmountPaise`.
- **02 → Verify Razorpay payment** — browser signature verification. Fill `razorpayPaymentId` and `razorpaySignature` from the Checkout.js success callback.
- **05 → Refund Razorpay payment** — ADMIN-only full refund of a captured Razorpay payment.
- **07 → Razorpay webhook** — manually signed `payment.captured` event. Set the **secret** environment variable `razorpayWebhookSecret`; the request computes `X-Razorpay-Signature` itself.

> The webhook route is `/webhooks/razorpay` (root, not under `/api/v1`). Localhost cannot receive real Razorpay webhooks; use the signed request in folder 07 only to test verification and processing.

## Notes

- **MUTATES** means the request changes demo data. Re-run `app\artifyme-seed.exe` (portable edition) to reset the six demo orders.
- Test scripts save tokens, user IDs, new order IDs and review IDs into **both** collection and environment variables, so either import style works.
- Requests expected to fail by design are in **06 - RBAC Negative Tests** (`401`/`403`).
- Checkout is provider-aware: `manual` mode returns `200` and moves no money; `razorpay` mode returns Checkout.js fields. A `503` means the selected gateway is not configured correctly.
- Responses that are already in a later state return `400`/`409`; the test scripts treat those as handled rather than failures.

item.name: 00 · Authentication & Tokens  (run these first)
item.description:
Run the **Login** requests in this folder first. Every login saves its JWT into collection/environment variables so the other folders work immediately.

| Request | Saves |
| --- | --- |
| Login · ADMIN — Ganesh | `adminToken`, `adminUserId`, `adminRefreshToken` |
| Login · ADMIN — Test Admin | `admin2Token`, `admin2UserId`, `admin2RefreshToken` |
| Login · CUSTOMER — Priya | `customerToken`, `customerUserId`, `customerRefreshToken` |
| Login · ARTIST — Rohan | `artistToken`, `artistId`, `artistRefreshToken` |
| Login · NEW ARTIST (optional) | `newArtistToken`, `newArtistId`, `newArtistRefreshToken` |
| Login · DELIVERY AGENT | `deliveryToken`, `deliveryAgentId`, `deliveryRefreshToken` |

**Then run the two `Sync ...` requests** at the bottom of this folder. They refresh all demo order IDs and user IDs from the live database, so the collection keeps working even after `artifyme-seed.exe` changes the UUIDs.

**No courier is pre-seeded.** Run **Register · DELIVERY AGENT** once before the courier login.

item.name: Sync demo order IDs  (run after ADMIN login)

request.description: **Recommended after any re-seed.** Reads the current orders and refreshes `orderIdPlaced`, `orderIdConfirmed`, `orderIdAssigned`, `orderIdInProgress`, `orderIdCompleted` and `orderIdPublished` from the live database, so the collection keeps working even when demo UUIDs change.

exec: function save(key, value) { if (!value) return; pm.collectionVariables.set(key, value); if (pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set(key, value); } }
const published = orders.find(o => o.status === "PUBLISHED") || orders.find(o => o.status === "COMPLETED" && o.is_published_to_gallery);
const fallback = placed || confirmed || assigned || inProgress || completed || orders[0];
console.log("Synced demo orders: placed=" + (placed && placed.order_id) + " confirmed=" + (confirmed && confirmed.order_id) + " completed=" + (completed && completed.order_id));

item.name: Sync user IDs  (run after ADMIN login)

request.description: Refreshes `adminUserId`, `customerUserId`, `artistId` and `deliveryAgentId` from the live user list. Useful after registering a new artist or courier.

exec: function save(key, value) { if (!value) return; pm.collectionVariables.set(key, value); if (pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set(key, value); } }
const admin = users.find(u => u.email === "ganesh@example.com") || users.find(u => u.role === "ADMIN");
const customer = users.find(u => u.email === "priya.customer@example.com") || users.find(u => u.role === "CUSTOMER");

request.description:
Creates the courier account used by the **Login · DELIVERY AGENT** request.

- Email: `{{deliveryEmail}}` = `courier.vikram@example.com`
- Password: `password123`
- Role: `DELIVERY_AGENT`

Run once. Re-running is safe and returns `409 Email already exists`; the login still works.

exec: pm.test("Created, or already exists", function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description:
**Courier account — create it first if needed.**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Email | `courier.vikram@example.com` |
| Password | `password123` |

The demo database has **no pre-seeded delivery agent**. Send **Register · DELIVERY AGENT** once in this folder, then send this login. The newly registered courier starts as `PENDING`, which can still sign in; use **ADMIN → Activate delivery agent** to set it to `ACTIVE`.

Optional helper for the **Verify artist** and **Reject artist** admin requests.

- Email: `postman.artist@example.com`
- Password: `password123`
- Role: `ARTIST` (starts `PENDING`)

On success this request stores the new `user_id` in `newArtistId`. If the account already exists (409), look it up with **ADMIN → List all users** and paste its ID into the `newArtistId` variable.

exec: pm.test("Created, or already exists", function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Rotates the admin refresh token. Requires **Login · ADMIN** to have been run in this Postman session so `adminRefreshToken` has a value.
Lists every active device/session for the signed-in admin.
Revokes all sessions except the one used by this request.
Simple API health probe.

Returns the public gallery built from verified artist work and published orders.
Supported categories: `PENCIL`, `CHARCOAL`, `WATERCOLOR`, `ACRYLIC`, `OIL`.
Returns the portrait product, categories, sizes and subjects with price factors.

item.name: 02 · CUSTOMER APIs  (Priya Patel)
item.description:
Folder-level authorization: `Bearer {{customerToken}}`.

Run **00 → Login · CUSTOMER** first. Requests that change demo data are marked **MUTATES**.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's `user_id`, `role` and `status`.
Full profile for the signed-in customer.
Updates name, phone and address. Empty fields are ignored.

item.name: Upload reference photo  (MUTATES · pick a file)

request.description: Select a JPG/PNG/WebP (max 10 MB) in the **Body → form-data → file** row. The response returns a `file_url` you can use when creating an order.

Creates a new `PLACED` order. The reference URL defaults to the value saved by the upload request; if you have not uploaded anything, set `uploadedFileUrl` to a valid path such as `/uploads/demo-reference.jpg`.

On success the new order ID is saved to `orderId` so the next requests can use it.

body.raw:
{
  "painting_category": "PENCIL",
  "reference_image_url": "{{uploadedFileUrl}}",
  "size": "A4",
  "persons_included": "SINGLE",
  "delivery_address": "42 MG Road, Bangalore, Karnataka",
  "customer_notes": "Created from the ArtifyMe Postman collection."
}

exec: pm.test("Order created or payload rejected", function () { pm.expect([201, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Every order that belongs to Priya, newest first.

item.name: Get order by ID  (completed demo order)

request.description: Returns the order plus its status history. `orderIdCompleted` is a preloaded `COMPLETED` order.

exec: pm.test("Order and history present", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.order).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(d.history).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Only `PLACED` orders can be edited. `orderId` defaults to the preloaded `PLACED` order; if you created a new order, it now points at that order.

exec: pm.test("Draft updated (or rejected because status changed)", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, JSON.stringify(pm.response.text())).to.be.below(500); });

request.description: Starts payment for a `PLACED` order. **Manual** mode (portable default) returns a mock `checkout_url` and records a dev payment; no money moves. **Razorpay** mode creates a Razorpay order and returns `key_id`, `razorpay_order_id` and `amount_paise` for Checkout.js. The response is saved into `razorpayOrderId`, `paymentId`, `paymentAmountPaise` and `checkoutProvider`.

exec: pm.test("Checkout handled (200; 503 means the payment provider is misconfigured)", function () {
console.log("Checkout provider=" + d.provider + " · local payment=" + d.payment_id + " · razorpay order=" + d.razorpay_order_id);

request.description: Verifies the Razorpay Checkout.js signature and confirms the order (`PLACED → CONFIRMED`). Checkout saves `razorpayOrderId`; paste `razorpayPaymentId` and `razorpaySignature` from the Checkout.js success handler (or the Razorpay test dashboard). Returns `503` in manual mode. The signed webhook is the authoritative fallback if the browser never returns.

exec: pm.test("Verify handled (503 in manual mode is expected)", function () {
pm.test("Payment is marked paid", function () { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("paid"); });
pm.test("Order is no longer awaiting payment", function () { pm.expect(d.order.status).to.not.eql("PLACED"); });
console.log("Payment verified · order " + d.order.order_id + " · status " + d.order.status);

request.description: Submits a review for the preloaded completed order. If that order already has a review, the API returns `400`; that is safe.

{

  "rating": 5,
  "title": "Beautiful portrait",
  "comment": "The likeness and shading exceeded my expectations. Created from Postman.",

exec: pm.test("Review created or already exists", function () { pm.expect([201, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Fetches the review attached to the completed demo order, if any.

Folder-level authorization: `Bearer {{artistToken}}`.

Run **00 → Login · ARTIST** first. Rohan is `ACTIVE` and `verified = true`, so assignment and status requests work.

request.description: Returns Rohan's bio, experience and verification state.
`bio` is required; `experience_years` must be 0–60.
Shows verification status and any rejection reason.
Lists paintings uploaded by the signed-in artist.

exec: pm.test("New artist painting added", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

request.description: Orders visible to the artist, including assigned and unassigned work.
`orderIdAssigned` is a preloaded `ASSIGNED_ARTIST` order. Run once; a second run returns a conflict because the status already moved on.
Completes the preloaded `IN_PROGRESS` order and generates the comparison collage. Run once.
Lists artists eligible for assignment (`verified = true`).

exec: pm.test("Only verified artists", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.verified_artists).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: 04 · DELIVERY AGENT APIs  (courier)
item.description:
Folder-level authorization: `Bearer {{deliveryToken}}`.

**Setup:** run **00 → Register · DELIVERY AGENT** once, then **00 → Login · DELIVERY AGENT**.

**Before the transit requests work:** use **05 → ADMIN → Assign delivery agent** on `{{orderIdCompleted}}`. Then run the status requests in order.

There is **no pre-seeded courier** in the demo database.

request.description: Orders assigned to this courier, plus parcels in delivery states.
Courier accepts the parcel and dispatches it from the studio. Assign the courier first in the Admin folder.
Courier is on the route to the customer.
Records a failed attempt and increments `delivery_attempts`.
Confirms physical handover at the customer's door.

item.name: 05 · ADMIN APIs  (Ganesh)
item.description:
Folder-level authorization: `Bearer {{adminToken}}`.

Run **00 → Login · ADMIN — Ganesh** and **00 → Sync demo order IDs** first. Requests that change demo data are marked **MUTATES**.

The **Demo orders** subfolder contains read-only GETs for every preloaded order state.

item.name: Demo orders · preloaded IDs
item.description: Six demo orders already exist in the portable database. These GETs let you inspect each lifecycle state immediately.

request.description: `orderIdPlaced` — use this for Confirm payment → Assign artist.
`orderIdConfirmed` — use this for Admin → Assign verified artist.
`orderIdAssigned` — use this for Artist → Start work.
`orderIdInProgress` — use this for Artist → Complete work.
`orderIdCompleted` — use this for Assign delivery, courier transit, and Confirm gallery publish.
`orderIdPublished` — already published to the public gallery.
Confirms the admin JWT is valid.
Every order across all customers, with artist and courier details.

Filter values: `PLACED`, `CONFIRMED`, `ASSIGNED_ARTIST`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `ASSIGNED_DELIVERY_AGENT`, `IN_TRANSIT`, `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY`, `DELIVERY_FAILED`, `DELIVERED`, `PUBLISHED`, `CANCELLED`.
Returns every user with role, status, order counts and artist verification. Use this to confirm the credentials below and copy any missing user ID.
Newly registered couriers start as `PENDING`. Run this after **Register · DELIVERY AGENT** and **Login · DELIVERY AGENT** so `deliveryAgentId` is populated.
Change a customer's account status. Keep `ACTIVE` to avoid locking the demo customer out; other common values are `SUSPENDED` and `PENDING`.
Artists waiting for portfolio review.
Admin view of the verified artist's uploaded work.

Approves an artist after portfolio review. Flow: **00 → Register · ARTIST** → **00 → Login · NEW ARTIST** → **03 → Add painting as NEW artist** → this request. Rohan is already verified and would return `409`.
Rejects an artist in review with a mandatory reason (at least 10 characters). Use a fresh unverified artist from **Register · ARTIST**.

ADMIN-only manual confirmation for a `PLACED` order (`PLACED → CONFIRMED`). In Razorpay mode the signed webhook or **Verify Razorpay payment** confirms automatically; use this endpoint as the manual fallback.

item.name: Refund Razorpay payment  (MUTATES · test mode only)

request.description: Full refund of a captured **Razorpay** payment for `{{orderId}}`. Only a `PAID` Razorpay payment can be refunded; manual payments return `400` and partial refunds are not supported. In live mode this moves real money. Set `orderId` to the order you paid in **Checkout → Verify**.

exec: pm.test("Refund handled (400/404 in manual or unpaid mode is expected)", function () {

request.description: Assigns Rohan (the verified artist) to the preloaded `CONFIRMED` order (`orderIdConfirmed`). Works immediately — no need to run Confirm payment first.
Generic lifecycle override. Change `status` to any valid state; `artist_id` is only needed for `ASSIGNED_ARTIST`. Demo order is `PLACED`, so `CONFIRMED` is the safe next step.
Publishes the completed demo order's collage to the public gallery. This is the direct override; the normal path is `DELIVERED → PUBLISHED`.

Assigns the courier to the completed order (`COMPLETED → ASSIGNED_DELIVERY_AGENT`). Re-assigning while the order is already `IN_TRANSIT` or `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` changes only the courier and **preserves** the current status, so the customer does not see the delivery step rewind. Requires **Login · DELIVERY AGENT** or **Register · DELIVERY AGENT** first.

Adds courier partner, tracking number, ETA and dispatch notes. These values appear in the customer's **My Orders**. Tracking buttons are generated only for Blue Dart, Delhivery and DTDC; other couriers show the AWB without a fabricated tracking link. Saving logistics does **not** change the order status.
Couriers eligible for parcel assignment. Empty until you register and activate one.
Background job worker metrics.
Event outbox relay metrics.
Optional filters: `min_rating`, `max_rating`, `is_featured`, `is_approved` (for example `?min_rating=4&is_approved=false`).
Average rating, CSAT, distribution and artist leaderboard.
Feature/approve a review. `reviewId` is saved automatically by **02 → Submit review** when it succeeds.
Reference/artwork image suites used by the admin demo and gallery.
**Privilege escalation:** promotes the artist in `newArtistId` to `ADMIN`. Only use on a throwaway test artist. Do not run against Rohan.

item.name: 06 · RBAC Negative Tests  (expected rejections)
item.description: These requests intentionally use the wrong role or no token. `403 Forbidden` / `401 Unauthorized` is the correct result.

request.description: A customer must not see platform-wide orders.
Artist-only endpoint.
Artists cannot list platform users.
Couriers cannot access the artist review queue.
Protected endpoint without an Authorization header.
Malformed JWT must be rejected.

Posts a signed `payment.captured` event to the public webhook route. Requires `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=razorpay` and the same `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` you put in the Postman environment as `razorpayWebhookSecret`. Set `razorpayOrderId` (saved by Checkout) and `razorpayPaymentId` (provider payment ID, not the local `payment_id`) to a recorded Razorpay payment, then send. The pre-request script computes `X-Razorpay-Signature` over the raw body. Localhost cannot receive real Razorpay webhooks; this request is for signature/processing tests only.

exec: console.warn("Set razorpayWebhookSecret in the environment to sign this webhook.");
pm.test("Webhook handled (503 without Razorpay configuration is expected)", function () {
